question_results.question: Explain the role of Hazrat Abu Bakr (RA) in the compilation of the Quran. [4 marks]
question_results.student_answer: Hazrat abu bakar help in compilation of Quran
question_results.correct_answer: After many Huffaz (memorisers) died in the Battle of Yamama, Hazrat Umar (RA) advised Abu Bakr (RA) to compile the Quran. He appointed Zayd ibn Thabit (RA) to lead the task. Verses were accepted only if confirmed by two witnesses (written and memorised). The result was a single authoritative Mushaf preserved by Abu Bakr (RA) and later passed to Hafsa (RA).

question_results.question: Describe the key events from the first revelation to the Hijrah to Madinah. [8 marks]
question_results.correct_answer: Level 1 (1-2): Basic mention of the Prophet receiving revelation. Level 2 (3-4): Description of first revelation, early converts (Khadija, Ali, Abu Bakr, Zaid), beginning of public preaching. Level 3 (5-6): Addition of persecution in Makkah, migration to Abyssinia, Year of Sorrow, Ta'if mission, Pledges of Aqabah. Level 4 (7-8): Comprehensive account including specific names, events, causes and significance of each stage. Excellent responses include the Hijrah itself, arrival in Madinah, and the historical significance.

question_results.question: Why was the standardisation of the Quranic text under Hazrat Uthman (RA) important? [4 marks]
question_results.correct_answer: Different regions were using different dialect copies leading to disputes. Hazrat Uthman (RA) formed a committee led by Zayd ibn Thabit to produce a standard text in the Qurayshi dialect. Multiple copies were sent to all provinces. Other copies were burned to prevent division. This preserved unity of the Ummah and ensured the Quran's authentic preservation.

question_results.question: Explain what happened during the Isra and Mi'raj (Night Journey and Ascension). [4 marks]
question_results.correct_answer: The Isra was the miraculous night journey from Makkah to Jerusalem (Al-Masjid Al-Aqsa) on the Buraq. The Mi'raj was the ascension through the heavens where the Prophet met previous prophets. Allah prescribed 50 prayers, reduced to 5 through Musa's (AS) advice. This event demonstrated the Prophet's special status and established the 5 daily prayers.

question_results.question: Describe the event of the first revelation received by the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). [4 marks]
question_results.correct_answer: The Prophet (pbuh) was meditating in the Cave of Hira when Angel Jibrail appeared and commanded him to "Iqra" (Read/Recite). The Prophet replied he could not read. The Angel embraced him three times. Then revealed the first five verses of Surah Al-Alaq. The Prophet returned home trembling and was comforted by his wife Khadija (RA) who took him to Warqa bin Naufil.
